name: IslamWeb — المكتبة الإسلامية (IslamWeb Library, islamweb.net)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §48 (probed 2026-11-26 from the build sandbox, multi-route): المكتبة الإسلامية of IslamWeb (إسلام ويب), one of the largest Arabic heritage libraries on the web, serving the full text of its books as page-based HTML (Shamela class), no login. Routes tried: (1) the library index /ar/library/index.php answers 200 with full book excerpts server-side; (2) the search-box route GET index.php?page=expsearch&stxt=<q> returns only the search FORM (results are JS-loaded), and POSTing the form fields (T1/R1/R2/range/wheretosearch/srchloc) to the same URL returns the form page again — no server-side results there; (3) the site's own search script exposes the real endpoint /ar/SearchEngine/explibtab.php, which answers 200 in ~3.5 s (الخوارزمي -> 11 items incl. سير أعلام النبلاء and a modern علوم حضارة الإسلام chapter on al-Khwarizmi; الفلك -> 41 items); (4) content pages /ar/library/content/<book>/<node>/<slug> answer 200 with the book's real prose in id='pagebody' blocks (سير أعلام النبلاء node 5325 = the biography of شاور, جزء 20, printed p. 515, read verbatim; لسان العرب node 9007 = 10,395 chars of dictionary prose); (5) the catalogue route index.php?page=bookslist (&subject=/&author= filters) answers but is catalogue-only — not needed; the /ar/library/pdfbooks/ wing exists but the HTML route is cleaner and complete. CAVEATS recorded honestly: the platform's stemmer is aggressive — a foreign name like البيروني is root-reduced and returns dictionary entries (لسان العرب on وري) instead of the name, so the searcher never trusts the match (passages are extracted from the FETCHED pages with the query terms and the unchanged screening/judges discard the noise); and the site intermittently serves a light page variant with no pagebody at all (the same URL answered 254 KB with the text and 89 KB without it, minutes apart), so every node fetch is retried once when it carries no book text. NO PRIMARY SEEDS: al-Biruni's own books are NOT hosted here (searches for القانون المسعودي and الآثار الباقية return other books MENTIONING them), so no IslamWeb candidate is marked primary.
